description: This file implements WebSocket and webhook server functionalities for Feishu integration, including signature validation, request handling, and server lifecycle management.

methods.name: isFeishuWebhookPayload
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a Feishu webhook payload object.

methods.name: buildFeishuWebhookEnvelope
methods.description: Constructs a webhook envelope combining request headers and payload.

methods.name: parseFeishuWebhookPayload
methods.description: Parses raw JSON string into a payload object if valid.

methods.name: isFeishuWebhookSignatureValid
methods.description: Validates the webhook request signature using headers and secret key.

methods.name: respondText
methods.description: Sends a plain text HTTP response with specified status code.
